episodes.title: Jochen
episodes.summary: The inspectors question a real estate developer about a missing handyman -- and the skeleton found beneath his first project in the former East Berlin.

episodes.title: Yilmaz
episodes.summary: A once clear-cut case of domestic violence grows murky as a powerful father-in-law's lawyer inserts himself into the mix to control the narrative.

episodes.title: Claudia
episodes.summary: A detective tries to extract the location of a body from a serial killer's hardened lover. Then the inspector puts herself on the line and steps in.
